name: Homebrew macOS package manager
description: Official Homebrew package manager for installing command-line tools and supported applications on macOS; Linux support is also documented by the project.
license_note: Homebrew itself is open source; individual formulae and casks have their own licences and publisher sources.
notes: Follow the official installation steps and review commands before running them.
Check formula/cask publisher source and licence before installing packages.
Do not use package-manager commands from untrusted catalogue entries.
